Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in the Bronx for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events. Free picks include the Winter Wonderland Family Day at The Bronx Museum (December 12) and Winter Wonderland at Williamsbridge Oval Recreation Center (December 11), and the Holiday Train Show at the New York Botanical Garden, Holiday Lights at the Bronx Zoo, Winter Haven at Wave Hill and the Bronx Little Italy tree lighting round out the list, with A Charlie Brown Christmas Live on Stage at Lehman Center on November 29. We check every date on the host's own website or the city's official listing, and each card links straight there.
